description: Verify that replan.json exists and is valid JSON
Ensure replan.json contains a 'replan' key with a non-empty array of steps
Confirm that the replan steps reference the failed assertion context
Validate that no step in replan.json is a blind retry (i.e., each step has a distinct action or condition)
command: jq -e '.replan | map(.action) | unique | length == length' replan.json
